issues.t: Brake pedal can collapse (recall)
issues.sym: The brake pedal may suddenly bend or give way under your foot, so the car will not stop as it should.
issues.why: The brake pedal arm on some cars was not strong enough. Recall 24V752, shared with the Dodge Hornet, has dealers add a reinforcement to the pedal arm.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls right away and book the free repair. If the pedal ever feels soft, bent or sinks, stop driving and have the car towed.

issues.t: Loose battery or high-voltage cable can cause a fire (recall)
issues.sym: There may be no warning. Possible signs are a burning or hot electrical smell, smoke, or electrical faults.
issues.why: A nut on the 12-volt battery positive cable or on high-voltage connections near the charging module may be missing or loose. A loose joint heats up and can start a fire whether the car is on or off. Recall 23V623 covers it.
issues.next: If it happens while you're driving: if you smell burning or see smoke, pull over where it's safe, turn the engine off, get everyone out and well away from the car, and leave the hood closed. Call 911 from a safe spot, even if you can't see flames. Don't drive it again until it has been repaired. If the recall is open, park outside and away from buildings and other cars until the dealer inspects and tightens the connections for free.

issues.t: Rearview camera image may not appear (recall)
issues.sym: The backup camera screen stays blank or does not show the camera picture when you shift into reverse.
issues.why: A display module fault keeps the camera image from showing. Recall 25V246 covers about 48,500 Tonales and Hornets; the fix is a software update or a new display.
issues.next: Back up slowly using mirrors and a look over your shoulder. Check your VIN for this recall.

issues.t: Rear seat belts can twist and not retract (recall)
issues.sym: A rear outer seat belt gets twisted and does not reel back in, so it stays loose.
issues.why: The rear outboard belt retractors can fail during normal use, so the belt may not hold a passenger properly in a crash. Recall 26V510 replaces them with redesigned parts.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall. Until it is fixed, make sure rear belts are untwisted and snug on passengers, and tell the dealer if one will not retract.

issues.t: Pedestrian warning sound may be missing (recall)
issues.sym: The car is silent when backing up in electric mode, so people nearby may not hear it.
issues.why: The outside pedestrian alert speaker was missing or unplugged on some plug-in hybrids. Recall 23V696 has dealers reconnect or replace it.
issues.next: Take extra care around pedestrians when reversing, and check your VIN for this recall.

issues.t: Tire label shows wrong load capacity (recall)
issues.sym: The tire and loading sticker in the door jamb lists the wrong maximum load.
issues.why: The placard printed an incorrect vehicle capacity weight, which could lead an owner to overload the car. Recall 24V175 adds a corrected label.
issues.next: Do not rely on the label for load limits until the dealer fixes it; check your owner's manual instead.

issues.t: Tire and rim size missing from label (recall)
issues.sym: The manufacturer's label does not list the correct tire and wheel sizes.
issues.why: Some labels were printed without the required tire and rim details. Recall 24V209 replaces the label.
issues.next: Check your VIN and have the dealer apply the corrected label for free.

issues.t: Check engine light from coolant pump fault codes
issues.sym: The check engine light comes on with codes about the electric coolant pump, sometimes along with air-fuel mixture codes.
issues.why: Stellantis has issued several software updates for the hybrid power inverter module and engine computer for these codes, and tells dealers to try the update before replacing the auxiliary pump.
issues.next: Have the codes read soon. A dealer can usually fix it with a software update under warranty.

issues.t: Fuel door won't open, with check engine light
issues.sym: The fuel door will not open at the pump, and the check engine light may be on with code P2450.
issues.why: On this plug-in hybrid the fuel tank is sealed by an isolation valve. A circuit fault in that valve keeps the fuel door locked. Stellantis released an engine computer update for it.
issues.next: Try the fuel door release in the owner's manual. If it still will not open, book a dealer visit for the software update.

issues.t: Driver-assist shuts off with radar blocked warning
issues.sym: A warning says the radar sensor is blocked, and features like adaptive cruise or emergency braking turn off. The check engine light may come on with code C1409.
issues.why: Dirt, snow or ice can block the front radar, but Stellantis also released a software update for the driver assistance module for this fault.
issues.next: Clean the front of the car around the radar. If the warning keeps coming back in clear weather, ask the dealer for the update.

issues.t: Engine and hybrid system shut off while driving
issues.sym: The car suddenly loses power as both the engine and hybrid system shut down, with little or no warning.
issues.why: An owner reported this to NHTSA after a hybrid generator was replaced under warranty; reprogramming did not stop it from happening again. The root cause was not published.
issues.next: If it happens while you're driving: turn on your hazard lights, hold the wheel firmly and steer to a safe spot off the road. Steering and brakes can feel much heavier when the engine or power cuts out, so press the brake harder than normal. Have it checked before you drive it again. Have the car towed to a dealer and report it to NHTSA.

issues.t: Brakes feel stiff, shudder or stop less than expected
issues.sym: The brake pedal feels unusually hard, the car is slow to stop or shudders, and stopping power is inconsistent. No warning light may appear.
issues.why: Owners have reported this to NHTSA, including one rear-end crash. The cause has not been confirmed; the hybrid system blends regenerative and friction braking, and faults there can change pedal feel.
issues.next: Leave extra stopping distance and have the brakes checked by a dealer right away. Also make sure the brake pedal recall has been done.

issues.t: Car lurched forward when the brake was pressed
issues.sym: While parking, an owner pressed the brake and the car moved forward instead, causing a crash.
issues.why: This is a single owner report; Alfa Romeo said its review found no manufacturing fault. NHTSA also has 2024 Tonale complaints about automatic emergency braking, some involving crashes.
issues.next: If your car ever moves unexpectedly, shift to Park, note the time and file an NHTSA report so the event data can be checked.

issues.t: Coolant seeping near the engine water pump
issues.sym: Coolant drips or residue around the water pump area, or a low coolant level.
issues.why: Stellantis published inspection steps for coolant found near the water pump and its weep chamber, a small reservoir meant to catch a little seepage.
issues.next: Check the coolant level when the engine is cold. If it keeps dropping or drips under the car, have the dealer inspect the pump.

issues.t: Phone app can't lock or unlock the car
issues.sym: Remote lock and unlock commands from the phone app fail.
issues.why: A firmware problem in the telematics box causes it. Stellantis released an update.
issues.next: Use the key fob, and ask the dealer for the telematics update.

issues.t: Theft alarm siren does not sound
issues.sym: The alarm does not make any noise when it is triggered.
issues.why: Stellantis issued a bulletin for an alarm siren that does not work.
issues.next: Have the dealer check the siren under warranty.

issues.t: Scheduled cabin preconditioning doesn't run
issues.sym: Scheduled warming or cooling of the cabin does not run, and a "Cabin Preconditioning Unavailable" message appears.
issues.why: A software problem in the hybrid control processors stops the schedule from running. Stellantis released updates.
issues.next: Ask the dealer for the hybrid control software update.

issues.t: Parking lights don't come on with remote start
issues.sym: When you start the car remotely, the parking lights do not turn on.
issues.why: Stellantis issued a bulletin for this electrical fault.
issues.next: This is minor. Mention it at your next dealer visit.

issues.t: Car delivered with only one key fob
issues.sym: You only got one key fob with the car.
issues.why: Stellantis issued a bulletin saying some cars were missing their second fob; the dealer orders a new one.
issues.next: Ask the selling dealer for the second fob under this bulletin.

issues.t: Sunroof glass shattered while driving
issues.sym: A loud crack, then the sunroof glass is broken around its edge, with no sign of anything hitting it.
issues.why: An owner reported this to NHTSA on a 2025 Tonale Veloce. The dealer treated the repair as goodwill, and the part took weeks to arrive.
issues.next: Pull over safely, close the sunshade and keep glass away from passengers. Photograph it and report it to the dealer and NHTSA.
